summary: Certified VIsita EMR DOB UX overhaul (frontend DobPicker + backend age gate). Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_dob_age_validation.py covering /api/auth/register, /api/applications/new-patient, /api/applications/return-request — exactly-17 accepted, one-day-under-17 rejected 400, exactly-99 accepted, 100 rejected 400, invalid calendar date (2023-02-29) rejected 400, garbage rejected 400/422, future DOB rejected 400. Frontend: Playwright certified reg-dob (Create Account → OHIP path) and np-dob (/register?new=1) flows end-to-end on Desktop (1440), iPhone (390x844) and Android (412x915). Verified: modal opens on YEAR (never calendar/month), Year→Month→Day→Confirm ordering, Back returns to previous step, Change returns to Year, close (X) dismisses, dynamic year range 1927..2009 (today=2026, ages 17-99), leap-year day counts (1984 Feb=29, 1983 Feb=28, June=30, January=31), Confirm displays 'YYYY Mon - DD' (e.g. '1984 Jun - 25'), trigger label updates post-Confirm. E2E submission of New Patient captured outbound payload: date_of_birth='1990-06-15' — stored ISO format unchanged. Mobile: bottom-sheet layout, no horizontal overflow, year tap targets 48px tall. re-dob flow (Re-establish Care) uses the same DobPicker component with identical test-ids (verified structurally in code); not exercised e2e because it requires backend to detect a seeded former patient. Preview-only — no deployment.
critical_code_review_comments: DobPicker.jsx: minYear = today.getFullYear() - MAX_AGE - 1 is intentional to cover the case where the user's 99th birthday has not yet passed this year — verified working (year 1927 selectable in 2026, and the day-step ageOf() disables days that would push age > 99). Good.
validate_dob_age() correctly uses full month/day comparison, so someone born tomorrow 17 years ago is still 16 today — verified via test_age_one_day_under_17_rejected on all 3 endpoints.
server.py is still 4,162 lines — long-standing refactor advice from iter42/43 still applies (unrelated to this change).

Re-establish flow (re-dob) not exercised e2e in this run because it requires a matched former patient in the DB; the DobPicker component itself is identical, and code inspection confirms setDob binding is shared. Main agent can self-verify by seeding a former-patient match.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for reg-dob + np-dob (all step-order, leap-year, mobile, e2e checks). re-dob structurally verified only.

seed_data_creation: Created ~7 TEST_agecheck new-patient applications and 3 TEST_agecheck return-requests via backend age validation tests (plus 1 e2e new-patient application via UI submission). All TEST_-prefixed for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://visita-admin.preview.emergentagent.com. Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_dob_age_validation.py -v to re-cert. DobPicker test-ids: <tid>-trigger, -modal, -years, -year-<YYYY>, -months, -month-<0-11>, -days, -day-<n>, -confirm, -confirm-value, -confirm-btn, -change, -back, -close. Three instances: reg-dob (Register step 2), np-dob (?new=1), re-dob (reestablish, requires former-patient path). Backend age gate lives in validate_dob_age() at /app/backend/server.py:408.
